2607.02055.title: Beyond the Performance Illusion: Structure-Aware Stratified Partitioning and Curriculum Distributionally Robust Optimization for Spatially Correlated Domains
2607.02055.paper_summary: Performance evaluation in AI systems commonly assumes that random dataset splits produce independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) subsets. We show that this assumption often breaks down in spatiotemporally correlated domains such as aerial surveillance, precision agriculture, and medical imaging, leading to two systematic failures: data leakage, where correlated samples span training and validation splits and inflate performance estimates, and hidden stratification, where errors on minority subpopulations are obscured by aggregate metrics. To address these issues, we propose a unified evaluation and training framework for spatially correlated data. We introduce Structure-Aware Stratified Partitioning (SASP), which constructs validation splits that reduce spatiotemporal leakage while preserving meaningful class balance, and Curriculum Distributionally Robust Optimization (CDRO), a curriculum-based relaxation of distributionally robust training that stabilizes optimization under these stricter splits. Across multiple benchmarks, this combination yields consistently improved generalization, more reliable confidence calibration, and exposes failure modes that remain hidden under conventional random-split evaluation.
2607.02055.paper_summary_zh: 性能評估在人工智慧系統中通常假設隨機數據集劃分產生獨立且同分佈（i.i.d.）的子集。<lb/>我們展示了這一假設在空間時間相關的領域（如空中監視、精準農業和醫學影像）中常常失效，導致兩種系統性失敗：數據洩漏，其中相關樣本跨越訓練和驗證劃分，並膨脹性能估計；以及隱藏的分層，其中對少數子群體的錯誤被總體指標所掩蓋。<lb/>為了解決這些問題，我們提出了一個針對空間相關數據的統一評估和訓練框架。<lb/>我們引入了結構感知分層劃分（SASP），它構建了減少空間時間洩漏的驗證劃分，同時保持有意義的類別平衡；以及課程分佈魯棒優化（CDRO），這是一種基於課程的分佈魯棒訓練的放鬆方法，能在這些更嚴格的劃分下穩定優化。<lb/>在多個基準測試中，這種組合持續產生改進的泛化、更可靠的信心校準，並揭示了在傳統隨機劃分評估下隱藏的失敗模式。
